title: Understanding the DataFrame
text: The DataFrame 'consoles' contains information about video game consoles, including their manufacturer, generation, type, year, and sales.

title: Identifying the Task
text: We need to find the latest generation a specific company participated in. This involves filtering the DataFrame based on the manufacturer and then finding the maximum generation value.

title: Filtering the DataFrame
text: To filter the DataFrame for a specific manufacturer, we use a condition that checks if the 'manufacturer' column matches the given company name.

title: Writing the Filter Condition
text: Write the condition to filter the DataFrame for the given company.
